summary: Ran the Svelte MCP autofixer across the app and UI packages, capturing per-file issues and suggestions, then reviewed existing test files, setup, and tsconfig to assess current coverage. Verified baseline health: svelte-check passed with 0 errors, all 165 app tests and 5 UI tests passed, but Prettier format check failed on 3 files.
decisions: Ran sveltejs/mcp svelte-autofixer across apps/app/src, packages/design/src, and packages/ui/src as a one-shot audit to enumerate issues/suggestions per file.

Treated Prettier format:check failure (3 files: .gizmo/config.json, apps/app/src/lib/features/settings/SettingsScreen.svelte, apps/app/src/styles/changes.css) as a known baseline state to be fixed separately rather than as a blocker for the current work.
Accepted the current test layout (App.test.ts, AgentStore.test.ts, WebSocketAgentClient.test.ts, load-web-extension.test.ts) as the existing structure to map against before reorganizing tests.
errors: Prettier --check failed: code style issues in .gizmo/config.json, apps/app/src/lib/features/settings/SettingsScreen.svelte, and apps/app/src/styles/changes.css (ELIFECYCLE, exit code 1).
Several .svelte files reported autofixer issues including missing `each` block keys, a `{@html}` XSS warning in a Markdown component, and a mutable Set instance in AgentSettings.svelte (line 76).
